title: Add norm-mode configuration and migration shim for reranker embedding compatibility
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: The reranking endpoint currently mixes behaviors across deployments: some clients rely on pre-normalized vectors and expect dot-product semantics, while others assume cosine similarity. This ambiguity causes subtle ranking regressions when we change embedding preprocess or swap model variants. Goal: Introduce an explicit, opt-in "norm_mode" and "distance_metric" configuration for the embeddings + reranker API, plus a runtime migration shim that preserves historical behavior by default. The change should be source-compatible for existing customers, provide clear opt-in for correctness (cosine vs dot), and avoid regressions in latency and memory usage. Key constraints: minimal footprint on hot path, support batched requests and streaming rerank responses, and allow runtime toggling via feature flags for canary rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: API: new query parameters accepted on /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank - 'distance_metric' (values: 'cosine'|'dot') and 'normalize' (values: 'none'|'l2'|'auto') documented and validated.
Backward compatibility: default behavior preserves current production outputs for existing customers unless they explicitly set params (migration shim in place).

Quality: for a held-out corpus of 10k production queries, switching to explicit cosine with normalize=l2 must have MRR drift < 0.005 relative to verified cosine baseline after opt-in tuning; any larger regressions require PM sign-off.
Latency: end-to-end p95 for reranker with normalize=l2 in a 16k token workload increases by <= 6% vs previous baseline after kernel-level batching optimizations.
Scaling: batch normalization implemented to amortize L2 cost; memory overhead for storing per-vector norms in cache <= 8%.
Rollout: feature-flagged canary to 5% traffic, verify regressions, then 50% then 100% with auto-fallback to previous mode on error rates or user-reported issues.
Tests: unit, integration, and regression harness added; CI must run the 10k query harness and fail on >0.1% output drift for existing-mode tests.
Docs: update SDKs and Console docs with migration guidance, recommended configs for common vector DBs, and an example migration plan.
tasks: Design API surface and validation rules (spec + OpenAPI) - include 'distance_metric' and 'normalize' fields.
Implement server-side migration shim that maps requests without explicit params to legacy behavior.
Add L2 normalization fast-path in C++ kernel and Node/Python bindings for batch normalization.
Add per-vector norm cache and backend storage hooks (Redis cache + optional DB column).
Benchmark: microbench normalization vs baseline, and end-to-end rerank p50/p95 with 1k/16k token payloads.
Regression harness: run 10k production queries comparing legacy vs explicit modes, capture MRR/Recall/precision deltas.
SDK changes: add parameter support and client validation; add migration warnings in the CLI.
Docs + migration guide: examples for Postgres/FAISS/Pinecone users and recommended 'auto' settings.
Rollout: create feature flag, monitor dashboards, schedule canary windows.
PR reviews and merge, post-deploy monitoring playbook.
